'''Mooring masts''' were reinforced metal poles installed at the [[Polis Massa Research Base]]. The poles used [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] to moor vehicles that were too large to fit in the Base's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
